_header.title: From Tariff Changes to Trade Effects: A Practical Framework for Empirical Trade Policy Analysis -- Study Configuration (study_config.json)
_header.description: The complete study configuration, STUDY_CONFIG, consumed by the end-to-end orchestrator run_task_25 and by every task-level callable of the Python reproduction of Cipollina and De Benedictis (2026). It is a value-for-value transcription of the revised and complete input specification (study_revised_inputs_20261109_222236.md), the notebook's single source of truth, and is equivalent to config.yaml: both load to the same mapping.

provenance_tags.[UNSPECIFIED IN MANUSCRIPT]: placeholder chosen by a declared rule; the rule is recorded so that the reproduction is auditable
provenance_tags.where_recorded: JSON has no comments; the per-key provenance tags and rules are carried as comments in config.yaml

conventions: Python tuples are stored as JSON arrays; run_task_25 accepts lists or tuples.
Python None is stored as null (a declared gap or an absent design term).
Fractions in the specification (1/18, 2/18, 5/18) are stored as their float64 values.
Non-ASCII characters (em dashes) are stored as UTF-8, not escaped.
_header.paper_reference: Cipollina, M., & De Benedictis, L. (2026). From Tariff Changes to Trade Effects: A Practical Framework for Empirical Trade Policy Analysis. Prepared for the 15th AIEAA Annual Conference (Rome, Universitas Mercatorum). Submitted 26 October 2026. arXiv preprint arXiv:2610.36171. https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36171
_header.author: CS Chirinda

interpretive_boundaries.exercise_purpose: illustrate mechanics, not rank winners and losers
interpretive_boundaries.conservation_note: the paper's Table 2 sums to roughly -155.8 bn USD, which is incompatible with a closed exercise; a conserving reproduction must report the residual against excluded cells as a finding
interpretive_boundaries.fixed_point_stationarity_finding: under eq. (14), d(beta_hat_k)/d(sigma_k) = 0 and every sigma_k is a fixed point; the iteration of eq. (U2) is stationary at its initial condition. This is the deepest analytical finding a reproduction must surface

preprocessing.product_level_principle: most disaggregated level at which tariff treatment differs across exporters and products

sample_construction.filter_population_effect: redefines the sample for every subsequent average and sum

tariff_construction.scenario_decimals_vs_factors: increment added to tau, not to (1+tau)

node_augmentation.vegan_endogeneity_recording: report |V_k| and its trade share, and how |V_k| varies with the applied MFN rate
node_augmentation.domestic_nonzero_assertion: the domestic node must respond in every market where any foreign margin moves; industries reporting identically zero domestic effects in Table 2 (8 of 17) require explanation

selected_partners_set_P.rationale: reconciles the China +17.0 and India +25.6 results with the amplification mechanism; the prior evaluation flagged the original config placing China inside S as contradicting its own test (item E2)

eq01_02_tariff_change.null_case_mechanism: MFN increase with preferential rate unchanged
eq01_02_tariff_change.insufficiency_claim: d tau_ik does not characterise the change in market access

eq03_ces_reference.alpha_construction_rule: alpha_i is proportional to s_ik * (1 + tau_ik)^(sigma_k - 1)

eq06_13_two_experiments.exporter_A_role: preferential supplier; own tariff unchanged in both
eq06_13_two_experiments.exporter_B_role: non-preferential supplier; own tariff is the shock
eq06_13_two_experiments.ceteris_paribus_clause: holding other elements of the benchmark constant
eq06_13_two_experiments.direction_liberalization_chain: tau_B down -> T_k down -> btm_A down
eq06_13_two_experiments.direction_protection_chain: tau_B_MFN up -> T_k up -> btm_A up
eq06_13_two_experiments.bilateral_measure_blind_spot: records no policy change for amplified-preference exporters

eq14_estimation.design_B_model: exp[ beta_own_k ln(1+tau_ikt) + beta_bm_k ln(1+T_kt) + gamma_it + delta_k + delta_t + theta ln E_kt ]
eq14_estimation.pe_disclaimer: single-importer truncation is not a full structural-gravity model
eq14_estimation.resistance_absorption: P_kt and E_kt absorbed by delta_kt; Pi_ikt and Y_ikt partly absorbed by gamma_it
eq14_estimation.resistance_failure_at_counterfactual: absorption valid for estimation; fails under counterfactual because absorbed terms are functions of the policy

eq19_decomposition.sign_own: d ln btm_ik / d ln(1+tau_ik) = omega_ik - 1 <= 0
eq19_decomposition.sign_cross: d ln btm_ik / d ln(1+tau_jk) = omega_jk >= 0
eq19_decomposition.uniform_shock_invariance: all foreign margins fall by a common factor when a uniform foreign shock is applied; domestic unchanged

P1_excluded_elements: tariff change as source of variation
P1_literature_space.P1_order_preservation_test: Kendall tau >= 0.95 with Spearman rho reported
P1_literature_space.P1_zero_claim_node_rule: place at centroid of circle, marked unclassifiable
P1_literature_space.P1_merge_rule: methodological papers with one design merged
P1_literature_space.P1_anomalous_citation: Dang, Krishna & Zhao (2003 in refs, 2026 in figure)
P1_literature_space.P1_self_count_claim: five at full strength vs maximum four elsewhere

P2_four_step_framework.compressed_schematic: Tariff shock -> Market access -> Elasticity -> Trade effect
P2_four_step_framework.definition_bias: error from choice of reference tariff
P2_four_step_framework.aggregation_bias: error from collapsing heterogeneous supplier treatments

P3_fixed_point.stopping_rule: until convergence, subject to existence and stability
P3_fixed_point.existence_check: report coefficient map range at the fixed point
P3_fixed_point.stability_check: spectral radius rho of the numerical Jacobian of F; require rho < 1
P3_fixed_point.structural_finding: under Design A, d beta_hat / d sigma = 0; every sigma is a fixed point; convergence is vacuous

NA2_ces_benchmark_network.induced_supplier_supplier_edges: complete graph, strength governed by sigma_k
NA2_ces_benchmark_network.aggregation_operator: PowMean_{1-sigma_k} over i with weights alpha

NA4_preference_network.asserted_structure: graph on country pairs with a preferential schedule per edge

NA5_production_network.asserted_structure: directed input-output linkages across sectors and countries
NA5_production_network.consequence: downstream incidence of sectoral tariffs outside the model

estimation_settings.fe_absorption_method: alternating projections for two-way HD FE
estimation_settings.separation_rule: detect and report; drop separating cells

table1.guard_not_a_decomposition: Table 1 is NOT an explicit decomposition of eq. (19)

table2.column_sum_check: must be zero under closure; paper's own sum is ~-155.8 bn

automated_instrumentation.permitted_use_only: coding abstracts into the nine-element ordinal scheme
prohibited_uses: generating tariff codes without human verification
automated_instrumentation.system_prompt:
You are coding one research ABSTRACT against a fixed nine-element codebook.
You will be given the abstract and the operational definitions of
the nine elements.

Return a JSON object with exactly nine keys E1..E9.
Each value must be one of 0, 0.5, 1, or "FLAG".

Use 1 only if the abstract explicitly claims the element as
defined. Use 0.5 only if the claim is partial or implicit under
the definition's partial-claim clause. Use 0 if the definition's
absence clause applies. Use "FLAG" only if the abstract is
genuinely ambiguous between two values; in that case state both
candidates in the 'diagnostic' field.

You will also be given, for each element, the exact verbatim
definitions for the 1, 0.5, and 0 cases. Apply them literally.
Do NOT reward a topic for being mentioned; a claim requires
that the abstract assert it. Do NOT infer from authors, journal,
year, or field. Do NOT use outside knowledge. Do NOT speculate
about the paper's body beyond what the abstract states.
automated_instrumentation.user_prompt_template:
ELEMENT DEFINITIONS (from the codebook; apply literally)
--------------------------------------------------------
{element_definitions_verbatim}

EXCLUDED ELEMENTS (do not code these)
-------------------------------------
{excluded_elements_verbatim}

ABSTRACT (verbatim; the only permitted input)
----------------------------------------------
{abstract_text}

Return the nine-field JSON object described in the system message.
For every non-zero or FLAG code, include a 'justification' field
containing a verbatim substring of the abstract that warrants it.
automated_instrumentation.validation_prompt_template:
You are auditing a coding decision against the codebook.
You are given one element's three-level definition and the
assigned code together with its claimed evidence span.

Answer only: (a) is the evidence span literally present in the
abstract; and (b) does the assigned code CORRECTLY APPLY the
three-level rule to that span — including, where the assigned
code is 0.5, whether the 0.5 clause applies rather than the 1 or
0 clause.

Reply with JSON:
{"span_present": true|false,
 "code_correct_for_span": true|false,
 "correct_code": 0|0.5|1|"FLAG",
 "reason": "<one sentence>"}

ELEMENT DEFINITION (all three levels):
{element_definition_full}
ASSIGNED CODE: {code}
CLAIMED EVIDENCE: {evidence_span}
ABSTRACT: {abstract_text}

G1_alpha_rule.primary: alpha_i is proportional to s_ik * (1 + tau_ik)^(sigma_k - 1), normalised to sum to 1
G1_alpha_rule.rationale: the only rule that reproduces observed shares identically after inversion; verified analytically and numerically
G1_alpha_rule.acceptance_test: predicted shares equal observed shares to 1e-12 for every (i, k)

G2_beta_k.rationale: the CES/Armington reading under a tariff-factor regressor; the map beta = sigma - 1 is the natural one; alternatives sigma = beta (which is admissibility-equivalent only if the regressor is a factor-ratio)
G2_beta_k.note: the paper never prints beta_hat; only sigma_bar_k appears in Table 1 col. 2; the derivation is a calibration, not an identification

G3_beta_to_sigma_map.selection: choose map reproducing Table 1 col. 2 to 2 dp

G6_product_level.test: verify tariff varies across i within k at the chosen level; if it does not, a coarser level is required
G6_product_level.open_question: at what level is V_k defined, and hence the CES benchmark computed — HS6, or ISIC 2-digit? The two give different network topologies and different margins; the choice must be declared

G8_repulsion_term.primary: iterative symmetric displacement below declared threshold
G8_repulsion_term.invariant: Kendall tau >= 0.95 over all pairs, with Spearman rho reported

G9_selected_partners_set_P.test: must reproduce China +17.0 percent, India +25.6 percent
G9_selected_partners_set_P.note: the prior config placed China IN S and thereby contradicted its own test; corrected (item E2)

G10_rule_precedence.report: both; note which matches Table 2 magnitudes

G12_conserving_reallocation.residual_reporting: report against excluded cells; the paper's printed sum is approximately -155.8 bn

T10_jacobian_zero_row_sum.identity: sum_j d ln M_i / d ln(1+tau_j) = 0 over V_k

T11_uniform_foreign_shock.identity: all foreign margins fall by a common factor; domestic unchanged

reconciliations_to_test: the beta-to-sigma map is not the identity (i.e., sigma = beta is correct, not sigma = beta + 1)
Table 2 aggregation is over product-level effects with offsetting signs within the industry
calibration_hazard_reconciliations.verdict_test: which of the three reconciles the +647 foreign net with the +7.88 percent margin

three_sequential_calibration_targets: sigma_bar_k vector (Table 1 col. 2) — isolates the elasticity pipeline
BTM levels (Table 1 cols. 3-4, 3 dp) — isolates alpha construction and baseline year
dollar effects (Tables 2-3) — isolates beta_hat, S membership, sectoral codes, precedence
deliverables_absent_from_paper: the beta-to-sigma map with selecting derivation
filter counts and excluded trade share
resolution of three missing citations and the Dang date
attribution table with own and benchmark components as separate columns

table2_arithmetic.row_sum_check: every row's net = integer sum of four components
table2_arithmetic.column_sum_check: column sum of net effects = 0 under closure
